verdict.rationale: The CLI has an output-format flag (`crwl ... -o markdown`), and the Python API returns markdown on the result object, with fit-markdown filtering and schema-based structured JSON extraction as further output options. There is no evidence of selecting HTML, plain text, or frontmatter output, so only part of the story is shown. Missing for 10: documented HTML, plain-text and frontmatter output options, a full list of format choices in the API/CLI, and independent hands-on corroboration.
